ev.q: 7,942 (34.4%) were part of 2,184 county-based genotype clusters
improved from 22 weeks in July 2010, to 11 weeks in December 2010
1,679 (76.9%) clusters consisted of two or three cases
In 2010, 40 (83.3%) of 48 reporting areas had >80% genotype surveillance coverage
improved from 22 weeks in July 2010, to 11 weeks in December 2010
compared with 26 (51.0%) of 51 reporting areas in 2004
For this report, 2004–2010 TB GIMS data from 51 reporting areas
with a goal to genotype at least one M. tuberculosis isolate for each case of culture-positive TB

methods_quotes.q: Measures of geospatial concentration were calculated by the log-likelihood ratio (LLR) for a given genotype cluster in a single county during a 3-year period
An LLR >5.0 indicates a potential outbreak.
TB GIMS timeliness data were examined during July–December 2010.
Three states among the 51 areas were excluded from the analysis because of delays resulting from technical problems.
